newsitem.title: USA: GRC International sets rev growth goal in 98.
newsitem.headline: GRC International sets rev growth goal in 98.

text.p: GRC International Inc said Thursday it has set a goal of growing revenues 10 to 12 percent in fiscal 1998, and it is targeting its debt as its number one priority.
The company also said it does not expect "meaningful quarter-to-quarter growth" in the first quarter of the current year.
The company reported a profit for the fourth quarter ended June 30 of $0.37 per share compared to a loss per share of $1.80 for the same period a year ago.
The company said the reversal was primarily the result of charges taken in the fourth quarter of 1996 related to the closing of one of its service operations.
Revenue were $31.3 million compared to $31.3 million.
